# argocd

Argo CD, which takes ownership of applying the cluster's manifests.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chart | string | `cataCharts.argocd.chart` | Store path of the Argo CD Helm chart. Required. |
| insecureRepo | boolean | `true` | Skip TLS verification when cloning.  True by default, and only defensible because the repository this clones is inside the same cluster: `internalUrl` is a Service address over plain HTTP, so there is no certificate to verify in the first place. A lab pointing Argo at a repository outside itself should turn this off and give it a CA.  |
| namespace | string | `"argocd"` | Namespace Argo CD runs in. |
| project | string | `"default"` | Argo project the repository is registered under. |
| waitTimeout | string | `"10m"` | How long an apply may take to settle. On whatever applies, which once Argo is here is Argo.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gateway | [API_GATEWAY](../signatures/API_GATEWAY.md) | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| generation | [SECRET_GENERATION](../signatures/SECRET_GENERATION.md) | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |
| git | [GIT_REPOSITORY](../signatures/GIT_REPOSITORY.md) | A git remote, addressed differently from inside and outside the cluster. |
